attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 16 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 13% of calls, and the model names 90 to 99% of them. It runs from `ytcA` through the `mdt` and `nrf` genes, [[multidrug efflux and nitrite reduction]], to `actP`.

**A variable column breaks it at 17.** `espX5` is carried by 66% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls, and named in 83%. Then columns 18 to 21 are spine again, 97% carried, `yjcE` to `soxS`, named 96 to 99%.

**The middle spine is interrupted twice.** Columns 23 to 28, `yjcB` to `aphA`, are spine at 91 to 97%, named 84 to 96%, and column 29, `yjbS`, is variable at 46%, the most hesitant column of the window at 1.09 bits. Columns 30 to 35, `tyrB` to `dusA`, are spine at 96 to 97%, named 83 to 97%.

**The last 44 columns are fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 36% of calls, named 83 to 95%. Two parallel branches run there: `sucD` to `odhB` through columns 40 to 43, carried by 10%, and `sorC` to `sorE` through columns 62 to 68, carried by 26 to 31%. The variable columns 45 to 61 carry the `mal` genes, [[maltose transport]], and columns 69 to 78 the `ace` and `pur` genes, [[glyoxylate cycle and purine biosynthesis]].

**The model names genes readily in the spine and hesitates in the variable stretches.** Inside a region of plasticity it names 70% of calls at 1.00 bits, against 96% at 0.24 bits outside. The window ends at column 79, `hupA`, in 34% of chromosomes.

label: ytcA
facts:
WINDOW: the ytcA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ytcA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,042 to 4,121 from dnaA. Read in 519 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ytcA once); 41,520 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.34 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,183 calls, named 99%, 0.17 bits; shell 7,869 calls, named 73%, 0.89 bits; cloud 468 calls, named 19%, 2.95 bits. Outside an RGP 36,097 calls, named 96%, 0.24 bits; inside an RGP 5,423 calls, named 70%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 33 spine, 16 fork, 31 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.24 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 96%); 5,423 of the 41,520 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 29 (yjbS) 1.09 bits, RGP 5%; column 36 (zur) 0.90 bits, RGP 21%; column 28 (aphA) 0.88 bits, RGP 5%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 36-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 12-36%; the least: column 17 (variable), RGP 0.4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-16 (17 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-13%. Genes: ytcA "YtcA family lipoprotein", mdtN, mdtO "multidrug efflux transporter permea…", mdtP, fdhF, yjcO "Sel1 family TPR-like repeat protein…", gltP, nrfG, nrfF, nrfE, nrfD, nrfC "cytochrome c nitrite reductase Fe-S…", nrfB, nrfA, acs, yjcH "DUF485 domain-containing protein", actP. named 90-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 5 (yjcO), named 90%; most hesitant at column 2 (mdtO), 0.61 bits.
2. column 17 variable: RGP 0.4%. named 83%; 0.79 bits.
   17: espX5 S 66%
3. columns 18-21 (4 columns) spine: share 97%, all P, RGP 0.4-2%. Genes: yjcE "Na+/H+ antiporter", ghxP, soxR "redox-sensitive transcriptional act…", soxS. named 96-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 21 (soxS), named 96%, 0.28 bits.
4. column 22 fork: RGP 4%. named 84%; 0.77 bits.
   22: pdeC S 87%; also "LrgB family protein" S 10%
5. columns 23-28 (6 columns) spine: share 91-97%, all P, RGP 4-5%. Genes: yjcB "YjcB family protein", ssb1, uvrA, yjbR "MmcQ/YjbR family DNA-binding protein", yjbQ "secondary thiamine-phosphate syntha…", aphA. named 84-96% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 28 (aphA), named 84%, 0.88 bits.
6. column 29 variable: RGP 5%. named 84%; 1.09 bits.
   29: yjbS S 46%
7. columns 30-35 (6 columns) spine: share 96-97%, all P, RGP 3-11%. Genes: tyrB, alr, dnaB, qorA, pspG, dusA. named 83-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 35 (dusA), named 83%, 0.67 bits.
8. columns 36-79 (44 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 12-36%. named 83-95% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 37, named 83%; most hesitant at column 36, 0.90 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 40-43, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all S; the branch's families: sucD, sucC, lpdA, odhB
   a second branch of 7 families through columns 62-68, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 26-31%, all S; the branch's families: sorC, sorD, sorF, sorB, sorA, "PTS system mannose/fructose/sorbose fam…", sorE
   36 fork: zur P 87%; also "DinI-like family protein" S 10%
   37 variable: yjbJ P 87% "CsbD family protein"
   38 fork: dinF P 87%; also "Ldh family oxidoreductase" S 10%
   39 variable: lexA P 87%
   40 fork: dgkA P 87%
   41 fork: plsB P 87%
   42 fork: ubiA P 87%
   43 fork: ubiC P 87% "chorismate lyase"
   44 fork: malM P 87%; also espX4 S 29%
   columns 45-61 variable, share 57-87%, 15 P, 2 S: lamB 87%, malK 87%, malE 86%, malF "maltose ABC transporter permease Ma…" 86%, malG 86%, xylE 60%, psiE 86%, "hypothetical protein" 57%, "hypothetical protein" 85%, yjbH "YjbH domain-containing protein" 85%, yjbG "capsule biosynthesis GfcC family pr…" 86%, yjbF "YjbF family lipoprotein" 86%, yjbE "exopolysaccharide production protei…" 86%, pgi 86%, lysC 85%, yjbD "DUF3811 domain-containing protein" 82%, rluF 80%
   62 fork: pepE P 74%
   63 fork: yjbB P 73% "Na/Pi symporter"
   64 fork: metH P 72%
   65 fork: iclR P 72%
   66 fork: espL4 S 35%; also "ShET2/EspL2 family type III secretion s…" S 17%
   67 fork: aceK P 71% "bifunctional isocitrate dehydrogena…"
   68 fork: aceA P 71%
   columns 69-78 variable, share 32-70%, 9 P, 1 S: aceB 70%, metA 69%, yjaB "acetyltransferase" 66%, yjaA "YjaA family stress response protein" 32%, purH 61%, purD 54%, zraR 49%, zraS 46%, zraP "zinc resistance sensor/chaperone Zr…" 43%, yjaH "DUF1481 domain-containing protein" 41%
   79 fork: hupA P 34%; also yjaG P 19%, nfi P 10%
